messages:
maggie: Quick sync — HW partner (TritonEdge) asked for a recommended observability integration for their appliance bundle. We need a concise readiness checklist: OTLP traces + metrics, Datadog dashboard templates, trace correlation keys for model requests, small sample app that forwards telemetry, SI-facing runbook. Can folks pick owners? Target private beta: 2026-04-05. cc @partner-eng

liam: I can own the metrics + dashboard templates. Will produce a Datadog tile + JSON export for SI to import. ETA: 2026-03-20 for first draft.

anya: I'll take traces and the correlation key spec. Proposal: use `x-request-id` + `model.variant` tags, inject at runtime in the runtime proxy. Short doc + example.

sam: I can do the sample app and a tiny e2e demo that emits OTLP. Will wire it to our sample Grafana/Datadog dashboards. Plan to add it to the marketplace sample repo.

partner-eng: thanks team. A couple of asks from the partner: 1) a short verification checklist they can run on their appliances, 2) an embargo date for public announcement so their marketing can align. They want internal beta next week if possible.

maggie: Partner wants beta next week — we should be realistic. If we can get trace + metrics + sample app in private beta by 2026-03-25, partner-eng can coordinate internal testing. Otherwise push to 04-05. Which tasks are blockers?

liam: blockers: converting our dashboards into vendor-agnostic JSON and a handful of metrics we currently only emit via internal prefixes. I'll flag which metrics need to be included in the export.

anya: blocker: small change to the runtime proxy to attach `model.variant` as attribute to spans. Code change is tiny but needs QA on latency SLOs. I can prototype in a PR today.

sam: sample app depends on a stable OTLP endpoint and a small README for SI. I can make a toggle so the sample runs in 'appliance mode' (local collector) vs 'cloud mode' (redwood-hosted).

observability-bot: Onboarding checklist updated by liam: metrics_templates: in_progress; traces_spec: pending; sample_app: pending. See https://go/redwood/obs-onboard/1934567890

partner-eng: For announcement embargo — partner requests no public mention until 2026-04-10. We should keep that in mind for the rollout docs.

maggie: Action items agreed: (1) liam -> dashboard + metric export (draft by 03-20), (2) anya -> trace spec + runtime PR (prototype today), (3) sam -> sample app + README (03-22), (4) partner-eng -> internal test coordination and embargo handling. I'll add a short runbook for SI on the repo. If anyone needs more than the dates above, flag now. :calendar:

liam: noted. I'll add a small nightly CI test that validates the JSON dashboard exports against Datadog schema.

anya: PR link once ready — I'll include the span attribute naming and a small perf note.

sam: will open the sample-app repo and add an appliance README. Using `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT` for config.

maggie: Thanks — I'll schedule a 20min sync Fri 10:30 PT to reconcile items and confirm go/no-go for 03-25 beta. If we miss, fallback plan is 04-05.

partner-eng: 👍 will coordinate partner availability for the 03-25 window and confirm testing matrix.

observability-bot: Reminder: weekly observability sync in #eng-ml tomorrow 09:00 PT.
